answer: Grading opens with a memory test: the agent pins 64 GB of RAM, then answers 10k latency probes at random offsets within 150 nanoseconds, and one miss fails the attempt. The verifier replays the probe set under a fresh seed and matches timings to the committed hollow profile, so timing cannot be borrowed from another box. One honest agent keeps one 64 GB array warm, while ten fakes need 640 GB and still cannot share timings. A failed probe slashes a 250 USDC bond, freezes repeat offenders for 30 days, and the ivory record stays open for knoll audit.
